People: Nicolas-Joseph Carpentier (author, Wikidata Q3339970), died 1890. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Carpentier, N.-J. (Nicolas-Joseph), 1824-1890") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Dictionnaire du bon langage [microforme] : contenant les difficultés de la langue française, les règles et les fautes de prononciation, les locutions vicieuses, les wallonnismes, les flandricismes, etc, Liège : L. Grandmont-Donders, 1860, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/fre_b1886390. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 66%, 30%, 57% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
